editor.1_load_a_matching_a2l_and_intel_h:
1. Load a matching A2L and Intel HEX pair.
2. Search by substring or * and ? wildcards; arrays use linear memory indices.
3. Double-click to edit and confirm the stored value; yellow rows are modified.
4. Preview, undo and save as HEX. Existing output files may be overwritten after confirmation; the source HEX is protected.

Not tied to variable prefixes or chip addresses. Unsupported layouts are marked explicitly.
RAM parameters absent from HEX cannot be read/edited; Flash mirrors are never guessed.
Overlapping calibration addresses cannot be edited. A2L limits are NOT hardware safety limits.
Vendor CRCs/signatures are not updated. See README for supported formats.
